Investors awaited a likely hawkish hold Fed decision and earnings from $GOOG and $MSFT today and $AMZN tomorrow. $SKHY surged on blockbuster results and its outlook that long-term memory demand will exceed supply through at least 2030, lifting Samsung and $MU in sympathy. We remain cautious on $TSLA given its extended valuation, negative earnings revisions, and our view that autonomous driving technology becomes a commodity over time.
